# Aesthetix Studio

> A digital product studio in Hyderabad, India. We design and build digital experiences,
> web applications and AI solutions that create measurable business impact.

Aesthetix Studio is a small product studio. Typical engagements are marketing websites
and landing pages, web applications and internal platforms, and AI features embedded in
existing products. We work as an embedded team from discovery through launch.

Contact: mohdabraralikhan@gmail.com · Hyderabad, India

## Services

- [Capabilities](https://aesthetixstudio.com/capabilities): What we do and how we help, across design, engineering and strategy.
- [AI Solutions](https://aesthetixstudio.com/ai-solutions): Automations and insights embedded directly in your product.
- [Website Redesign](https://aesthetixstudio.com/website-redesign): Reimagine an existing site around your business goals.
- [SEO Service](https://aesthetixstudio.com/seo-service): Technical SEO, content and authority building.
- [Website Audit Tool](https://aesthetixstudio.com/website-audit-tool): Technical, UX and content issues across a site.
- [Performance Analyzer](https://aesthetixstudio.com/performance-analyzer): Core Web Vitals and load performance per page.
- [Design System](https://aesthetixstudio.com/design-system): Our design tokens and components.
- [Process](https://aesthetixstudio.com/process): How an engagement runs, from discovery to launch.

## Work

- [Case Studies](https://aesthetixstudio.com/case-studies): The work, in depth.
- [Luminary Financial](https://aesthetixstudio.com/work/luminary-financial): A wealth management platform built for clarity and trust.
- [Kora Health](https://aesthetixstudio.com/work/kora-health): A patient-first platform for complex healthcare journeys.
- [Vertex](https://aesthetixstudio.com/work/vertex): An analytics platform that turns operational data into decisions.
